title: Birdo VPN connect protocol
description: GENERATED by birdo-web backend/src/vpn/contract/protocol-schema.ts from ConnectDto, multiHopConnectSchema, ConnectionResult, HeartbeatResult and the error codes VpnController emits. Do not edit; run `npm run contract:generate` in backend/. Pinned by protocol-schema.spec.ts.

ConnectRequest.description: POST /vpn/connect body. Every field optional on the wire (older builds); unknown properties are refused (ValidationPipe forbidNonWhitelisted).

MultiHopConnectRequest.description: POST /vpn/multi-hop/connect body. .strict(): unknown properties are refused. Not expressible here: entryNodeId must differ from exitNodeId.

rosenpassPublicKey.description: Quantum Protection (BirdoPQ v1): the ML-KEM-1024 CIPHERTEXT the server encapsulated against the request's pqClientPublicKey, base64. This is the canonical wire name for it (kept from the Rosenpass era for wire compatibility): there is no pqCiphertext alias, sent or accepted. Present when quantumEnabled is true.

rosenpassEndpoint.description: Quantum Protection (BirdoPQ v1): the per-connect NONCE, base64, the HKDF info the client derives the WireGuard PSK with (with the decapsulated secret). This is the canonical wire name for it: there is no pqNonce alias, sent or accepted. Not an endpoint despite the name. Present when quantumEnabled is true.

quotaExceeded.description: FREE-TIER CAP: true, with success:false, when a free account has used its whole data allowance for the period; message says how much and when it resets. Companion of success:false: STOP auto-reconnecting. Every connect is refused the same way until the reset or an upgrade.

refusalReason.description: Why the connect was refused (with success:false), machine-readable: key the client screen on this, never on message wording. device_limit: the device cap of the plan is reached (device screen or upgrade; a retry changes nothing). plan: the server, or every server, is outside the plan (upgrade, or pick an included server). quota_exceeded: the free data allowance is used up (always with quotaExceeded:true). server_capacity: the chosen server is full (pick another). server_unavailable: the chosen server is missing or not ONLINE, or none can be used now (pick another, or retry later). Absent on a success, on a rebuild refusal (rebuildRefused) and on other failures. Older servers never send it: treat an absent or unknown value as a refusal without one and show message.

ConnectResponse.description: Body of a 200 from POST /vpn/connect and /vpn/multi-hop/connect. success:false + message, with refusalReason (ConnectRefusal) when the connect was refused for a reason the client can act on, and rebuildRefused when a rebuild was refused untouched. Extra keys may appear; clients must ignore unknowns.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable `error` values the connect routes emit. Other failures carry free-text `message` only.

ConnectRefusal.description: ConnectResponse.refusalReason values (success:false; MR-139). device_limit: device cap reached. plan: outside the plan. quota_exceeded: free allowance used up. server_capacity: the server is full. server_unavailable: the server is missing or not ONLINE, or none is usable now. Full semantics: CONNECT_REFUSALS in vpn.service.ts. Treat an unknown value as absent.

HeartbeatResponse.description: Body of a 200 from POST /vpn/heartbeat/:keyId. valid/serverOnline/message are unchanged from before `reason` existed; `reason` (HeartbeatReason) says what to do. Servers that predate it omit `reason`: treat an absent or unknown value as a reply without one. FREE-TIER CAP: quotaExceeded is true while the account is over its data allowance and on every quota_exceeded; while the grace window of a free session runs (valid:true, reason ok or server_offline) quotaGraceEndsAt / quotaGraceSecondsRemaining say when the server ends it. Extra keys may appear; clients must ignore unknowns.

HeartbeatReason.description: HeartbeatResponse.reason. ok: live. server_offline: connect to a different server (valid:true = key live but server not ONLINE; valid:false = server drained or deleted). revoked: ended by the user, the account or a plan change; stop, no automatic reconnect. evicted: a newer connection on the account took the slot; stop, NEVER reconnect automatically. reaped: released by server housekeeping (no check-in for 5 min and no WireGuard handshake in that time, or the key expired; a handshake keeps a key at most 12 min past its last check-in, and only while the account is in good standing and signed in on the device); one quiet rebuild is safe. quota_exceeded: the free data allowance is used up and the server ended the session (always with quotaExceeded:true); stop, no automatic reconnect — a connect is refused until the reset or an upgrade. not_found: no record of why; handle as a reply without reason. Full semantics: HEARTBEAT_REASONS in vpn.service.ts.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The GlobalExceptionFilter envelope every connect error rides in. Each error code below references it, pins statusCode and error, and adds its own details.

RetryableDetails.description: details of a retryable connect refusal: nothing is wrong with the account; retry the same connect after retryAfterSeconds.

update_required.description: HTTP 426. Client below the platform support floor (or missing clientPublicKey below the key-custody floor), or a quantumProtection request without pqClientPublicKey + pqClientCanDecapsulate:true (refused on every platform; minVersion is "latest" when no version is known). details carries the versions.

client_attestation_required.description: HTTP 403. Attestation policy refused this build. Only message accompanies it on the wire.

quota_check_unavailable.description: HTTP 503. A FREE (RECON) account was refused because its data allowance could not be read — the free-tier cap fails closed. Retryable: nothing is wrong with the account; retry after details.retryAfterSeconds. Paid plans never receive it.

psk_delivery_unavailable.description: HTTP 503. The connection's pre-shared key could only have reached the server over the SSH fallback, which never carries one; the peer was rolled back, nothing was downgraded. Retryable after details.retryAfterSeconds.

tunnel_address_unavailable.description: HTTP 503. No tunnel address could be proven free on this server just now: a reservation the allocator must read did not answer, and it fails closed rather than risk giving one customer another's address. Nothing is wrong with the account or the server; retry after details.retryAfterSeconds.
